The reported surface area is not directly comparable with the net room standards for a micro-nursery and cannot establish capacity or suitability. Urban-planning compatibility, change-of-use requirements, health and safety standards, accessibility, and the applicable authorization process require verification. The supplied regulatory result found no requirements, and the listed gross-area thresholds are unverified.
pros: Energy class B meets the preference for class C or better.
Green proximity percentile of 81.8 supports the preference for access to neighborhood green space.
Residential dwelling type and 99.0 sqm surface area provide a basis for assessing adaptive reuse, subject to layout and technical checks.
cons: No data establish quiet street conditions or convenient parent drop-off parking.
The 99.0 sqm property surface area does not establish compliance with net childcare space standards, capacity, or provision of outdoor area.
Urban-planning compatibility, change of use, accessibility, health and safety requirements, and sector authorization remain to be verified.
